senses.gloss: (b. h. זַן ; Syr. זן qualitas, modus, P. Sm. 1138, sq.; cmp. זֶה, a. מִין a. מַה) quality, nature; kind, species.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 1:11">Targ. Gen. I, 11</cite> <he>לִזְנֵיהּ</he> after its kind.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 11:14">Targ. Lev. XI, 14</cite> <he>לִזְנָהּ</he>; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 32a:12">Ber. 32ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>מלי כרסיה זנא בישא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>זְנֵי בישי</he>) filled stomachs are a bad sort (plenty is tempting).—Pl. <cite ref="G00579"><he>זְנֵי</he></cite>, <he>זֵינֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 1:21">Targ. Gen. I, 21</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 16b:19">B. Kam. 16ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>זנים</he>, <cite ref="II Chronicles 16:14">II Chr. XVI, 14</cite>) <he>זני זני</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <he>זיני</he>) various species.
